title: Media Accordion Allentown
description: A reusable topic section with a localized introduction, optional CTA group and media, and one or more accessible accordion items.

theme.description: CMS-selected presentation setting passed to the renderer.

ctas.description: Optional primary and secondary actions below the introduction.

media.description: Optional editor-selected media, localized per locale. The renderer removes the media column when absent.

items.description: An unordered list of accessible accordion items.
